messages:
maria: FYI incoming high-priority escalation from Acme Payments — their production parser is failing on our JSON-mode responses intermittently. Ticket C-9982. They say outputs are sometimes truncated or have trailing non-JSON text. Sample payload they sent below.

eli: can you paste the exact request they sent (model, params, streaming on/off, prompt)? also need their client parser error message.

maria: they attached this snippet and the downstream error: 'Unexpected token \"<\" at position 124' — they suspect extra markup appended. request details: model: rdx-large, streaming: true, mode: structured/json, max_tokens: 512, stop: none.

maria: sample response from our API (as-received by customer):

```
{"order_id": "12345", "status": "approved", "amount": 102.50}
--
Note: processed by Acme internal pipeline
```

eli: that looks like a streamed response where the agent appended a human note after the JSON object — streaming or post-processing may be adding suffix lines.

josh: :eyes: quick hypotheses: (1) model produced a valid JSON then in the same stream emitted a separate final token chunk with extra text (common if stop sequences not enforced), (2) our streaming chunk boundary merging accidentally inserts a delimiter, (3) a post-processing hook (templating/logging) appended the note.

sam: customer says this happens ~1-3% of calls and is causing immediate failures in their payment pipeline. They're asking for a patch or workaround ASAP — they requested an ETA for a hotfix.

eli: immediate workarounds we can give them: 1) switch streaming off (stream=false) until we root-cause; 2) use a tolerant JSON parser that extracts the first top-level JSON object (e.g., read until matching braces) as a short-term mitigation; 3) set an explicit stop token that follows the JSON (we can suggest sending "\\n<<END_JSON>>" appended by the prompt). will send sample patch to their engineering contact.

josh: I'm triaging on the runtime side. Can engineering repro with a streaming client that simulates partial disconnects? I'll add a test that concatenates stream chunks and validates we never mutate model output. tagging @oncall-eng to prioritize.

oncall-eng: assigned, will take a look. if this is a streaming edge-case we should prioritize a patch. ETA for initial analysis: 2 hours.

maria: proposed customer comms: apologize, share workaround (disable streaming / parser tolerance / stop token), say we're investigating and expect an update within 4 hours. want to confirm before I send.

eli: agree. add a repro snippet they can try instantly: non-streaming curl example and a small client-side extraction regex.

maria: sending now. snippet:

```
# curl non-streaming example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-large","stream":false,"mode":"structured","prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":512}'
\n# simple tolerant extractor (python)
import re
m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", response_text, re.S)
if m:
    obj_text = m.group(0)
    # then json.loads(obj_text)
```

sam: customer replied: tried non-streaming and saw no extra trailing line. they've applied the workaround for now.

josh: root cause path: add tests for streaming -> boundary trimming; audit post-processors to ensure no appended logs; look at any middleware that injects notes on specific customers. if we find middleware was appending notes, revert immediately.

devbot: deploy pipeline detected no recent canary changes to runtime in the last 24h.

eli: okay next steps: josh to run reproduction and validate whether stream chunking can emit extra text, oncall to check any middleware hooks, eng to prepare hotfix if needed. support to send interim comms and escalate to enterprise success for SLA bookkeeping.

maria: I'll confirm SLA notes with Acme (they're enterprise; this is impacting payments). I'll message them the 4-hour update window and the workaround steps now. :thumbsup:

josh: logging accepted. I'll post findings in this thread when I have a repro.

oncall-eng: update: found a templating hook that appends a short note when a conversation contains the word "invoice" — disabling for production now and rolling a hotfix to canary. follow-up in ~30m.

maria: awesome. please ping when canary is verified so I can tell the customer.

josh: verified on canary: no suffix text after JSON in 1000 simulated streams. preparing rollout to prod.

maria: told customer: hotfix deployed to prod, please confirm their pipeline is green. they replied OK, parser errors stopped. closing internal ticket after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
